core.title: 15 Inch Warwick Push Plate, Acorn WNBBP

text.description_html:
Acorn WNBBP, Rough Iron Warwick 15" Door Push Plate

This 15" Warwick Rough Iron door has decorative forged crests on both the top and the bottom. Surface mounting, it is easy to install with just a few screws. The rough iron surface duplicates that found on the ironwork of many old European castles and cathedrals and imitates the natural weathering of iron; and because it is made by Acorn, the WNBBP Rough Iron Warwick Push Plate has a lifetime no rust warranty.

Also Available: Matching Door Pull

Features of the Warwick Rough Iron Push Plate:

  • Finish: Rough Black Iron
  • Height: 15"
  • Width: 3"
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!

Sold individually. Package includes 1 push plate and hardware for a surfaced mounting application. This door push plate is handmade and all dimensions are approximate.
